profile.summary: TruCap Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides loans in India. The company operates in two segments, Fund Based Activities and Advisory Services. It offers micro enterprise loans, SME loans, other structured business, personal loans, and gold loans, as well as related ancillary services.
